cat > /workspace/submission/build.py <<'EOF'
"""Offline standard-library-only Rust build driver.

Build products live in a fresh TMPDIR (never in the frozen submission tree).
A content digest of the sources allows a repeated invocation to reuse an
already built engine; the binary is published atomically.
"""
import hashlib, os, pathlib, subprocess, sys, tempfile

base = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
tmp = os.environ.get('TMPDIR') or tempfile.gettempdir()
out = pathlib.Path(tmp) / 'unit-merge-build'
out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
engine = out / 'engine'
stamp = out / 'engine.stamp'

def source_digest():
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    parts = sorted((base / 'src').rglob('*.rs'))
    parts += [base / 'build.py', base / 'build.sh']
    for path in parts:
        digest.update(str(path.relative_to(base)).encode('utf-8'))
        digest.update(b'\0')
        digest.update(path.read_bytes())
        digest.update(b'\0')
    return digest.hexdigest()

def main():
    digest = source_digest()
    if engine.exists() and stamp.exists():
        try:
            if stamp.read_text().strip() == digest:
                return 0
        except OSError:
            pass
    env = os.environ.copy()
    env['LD_LIBRARY_PATH'] = '/opt/rust/lib'
    flags = ['/opt/rust/bin/rustc', '--edition=2021', '--target', 'x86_64-unknown-linux-musl',
             '-C', 'opt-level=2', '-C', 'codegen-units=1', '-A', 'warnings']
    rlib = out / 'librust_unit_merge.rlib'
    subprocess.run(flags + ['--crate-name', 'rust_unit_merge', '--crate-type', 'rlib',
                             str(base / 'src/lib.rs'), '-o', str(rlib.with_suffix('.rlib.tmp'))],
                   env=env, check=True)
    os.replace(str(rlib.with_suffix('.rlib.tmp')), str(rlib))
    binary = out / 'engine.tmp'
    subprocess.run(flags + ['--crate-name', 'rust_unit_merge_cli', '-C', 'link-arg=--threads=2',
                             '-C', 'linker=/opt/rust/lib/rustlib/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/bin/rust-lld',
                             str(base / 'src/main.rs'), '--extern', 'rust_unit_merge=' + str(rlib),
                             '-o', str(binary)], env=env, check=True)
    os.replace(str(binary), str(engine))
    stamp.write_text(digest + '\n')
    return 0

if __name__ == '__main__':
    raise SystemExit(main())
EOF
